title: ashwingopalsamy/euro-area-deposit-facility-rate-dataset / transmission
description: How the policy rate reaches common loans: the benchmark each is priced off, how often it resets and how directly a change passes through. Curated reference notes.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the jurisdiction (EA for the euro area).

benchmark.description: What the rate is priced off.

spread_bps.description: Typical spread over the benchmark, where given.

adjusts.description: `payment`, `tenure` or `both`: what changes when the rate does.
